::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1870]  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd)
What do you say to the name, and the page—as we have in the 1st Crusade, shall you have [Gibbon](other_books/otherbook_412.qmd)’s first Crusaders at Constantinople.[^1]

(N.B.—Gibbon did not blunder about the Athanasian Creed, but the American Church was not in his time.)

And is Anselm to come in.

I have sent for the introduction to re write [sic] it.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This letter evidently refers to the joint editorial work on *European History* (1870), the second of two anthologies of excerpts from historical writings which CMY and Sewell had published.
